arena_context_desc: cinematic top-down view of a mystical ancient ritual forest clearing at night with glowing moss and dark obsidian roots
static_hold_desc: still dark ancient forest clearing with motionless roots and silent moss
negative_desc: gravel, sand, dirt, brown mud, blurry, noisy, text, watermark, box, cage, wireframe, modern buildings, cars, daytime glare

e0_s0.essence_desc: a glowing cyan-blue spirit lantern floating along the left fern trail
e0_s0.action_desc: casts piercing sapphire light beams toward the left fork of the forest

e0_s1.essence_desc: a blazing golden ritual torch advancing straight down the central aisle
e0_s1.action_desc: projects radiant solar rings straight ahead through the sacred grove

e0_s2.essence_desc: a swinging crimson-violet ritual censer drifting toward the right root path
e0_s2.action_desc: releases swirling magenta-gold incense waves into the right forest fork

e1_s0.essence_desc: an overarching emerald-green canopy of giant bioluminescent ferns
e1_s0.action_desc: parts its glowing green fronds to open a living archway in the woods

e1_s1.essence_desc: a sacred amphitheater of intertwining jade-green glowing tree roots
e1_s1.action_desc: unfurls luminous moss petals across the forest floor like a ritual mandala

e1_s2.essence_desc: a towering cathedral of ancient amber-gold tree trunks with glowing sap veins
e1_s2.action_desc: resonates with concentric golden ripples through the woodland pillars

e2_s0.essence_desc: a majestic translucent white-violet crystal stag spirit with branching antlers
e2_s0.action_desc: steps into the clearing as its antlers refract golden-violet starlight

e2_s1.essence_desc: a swirling chorus of luminescent amethyst-and-cyan ritual moth masks
e2_s1.action_desc: dances in a hypnotic spiral around the clearing, folding space and shadows

e2_s2.essence_desc: a carved magenta-gold obsidian totem monolith with glowing rune eyes
e2_s2.action_desc: projects geometric forcefields of violet light across the mossy crossroads

e3_s3.essence_desc: a swirling silver-cyan ritual mist vortex over a mirror-like forest pool
e3_s3.action_desc: ripples with liquid starlight that reflects and transforms the seeker's flame

e3_s4.essence_desc: a crackling cobalt-gold ritual lightning font suspended above the roots
e3_s4.action_desc: arcs with branching electric-gold tendrils that recharge the spirit lantern

e3_s5.essence_desc: a blazing ruby-and-gold astral eclipse ring hovering in the forest clearing
e3_s5.action_desc: pulsates with ceremonial solar shockwaves thatrebirth the traveler's light

quest.ongoing_hypothesis: the dark forest canopy stands closed before the floating ritual light at the crossroads
quest.completed_hypothesis: the ritual light illuminates the chosen fork and the glowing forest trees part into a luminous archway
quest.failed_hypothesis: the forest shadows swallow the trail

quest.ongoing_hypothesis: the glowing forest clearing is quiet as shadows gather near the roots
quest.completed_hypothesis: bioluminescent emerald and golden tree roots awaken a radiant crystal totem spirit in the center of the grove

quest.ongoing_hypothesis: the crystal totem spirit stands before the calm dark forest pool
quest.completed_hypothesis: violet-gold beams from the totem spirit ignite a swirling elemental omen of lightning and astral fire
quest.failed_hypothesis: the elemental omen fades into mist

quest.ongoing_hypothesis: the seeker's ritual light hovers before the surging elemental omen
quest.completed_hypothesis: the astral omen engulfs and transmutes the seeker's flame into a new radiant form for the next forest fork
